shortDescription: Gather information about LogicMonitor objects (e.g. collectors, collector groups, devices, device groups, etc.).

options.name: access_id
options.description: The Access ID API token associated with the user's account that's used to query the LogicMonitor API. Please contact your LogicMonitor admin if you need new API tokens created for your account.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The Access Key API token associated with the user's account that's used to query the LogicMonitor API. Please contact your LogicMonitor admin if you need new API tokens created for your account. Must start with the "!unsafe" keyword if the the key starts with a special character (e.g. '[', ']', etc.) to prevent playbook issues.

options.name: company
options.description: The LogicMonitor account company name. A user logging into their account at "batman.logicmonitor.com" would use "batman".

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the collector to target.

options.name: display_name
options.description: Display name of the device to target.

options.name: full_path
options.description: Full path of the device group to target. Root group full_path should be denoted by empty string "" or "/".

options.name: hostname
options.description: Name (hostname) of the device to target.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the collector, device, device group, escalation chain, etc to target.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the collector group, alert rule, escalation chain, etc to target.

options.name: size
options.description: The number of resources/results to display (max is 1000).

options.name: target
options.description: The type of LogicMonitor object you wish to query.
